_comment: The lesson sections (docs/CONTENT_GUIDE.md §1): the one list build.py (tools/buildlib/lessons.py), the lesson page (manifest.sections -> app/js/views/lesson.js) and the formula sheets (app/js/views/revise.js) read. `order` is every allowed ## section in its order; `required` must be present in every lesson; `oneOf` lists groups of which a lesson needs at least one (a warning otherwise: a numerical lesson has Formats and formulas, a theory lesson an Answer frame); `level` is the reading depth (1 Quick, 2 Exam, 3 Deep; unlisted = 2); `role` names the sections the app treats specially (facts = the formula-sheet facts, tricks = the exam-angle boxes). Changing a name here renames it for the build and the app at once; the lead owns this file.
